rationale: T078 proves runtime, browser assertions, zero Axe violations, screenshots, cleanup, and integrity preservation. Fresh visual review shows the desktop hero is materially too tall, while fixable source gaps remain in principles layout, footer logo treatment, newsletter disabled behavior, ARIA semantics, responsive rhythm, and full-page evidence. Media, fonts, additional news, and GitHub destination facts remain gated and must not be invented.

Preserve exact truthful copy, six registry-driven projects, the single published news record, provenance-pending media slots, fallback fonts, existing standalone/Docker behavior, and immutable snapshots. Then capture fresh full-page light desktop, mobile, and dark diagnostics with task-correct metadata.

Confirm all media remains data-media-slot=provenance-pending and no raster, font, news, external URL, content registry, snapshot, or report files are added.
stop_if: Any write is needed outside allowed_files, including content registries, page source, snapshots, reports, plans, documentation, provenance records, generated media, fonts, or external systems.
Verified GitHub destination, raster license/provenance, font provenance, or additional truthful news record is required; preserve the gap instead of inventing it.
Any visual:update, baseline approval, snapshot modification, assertion weakening, external activation, or invented copy/fact is attempted.
Port ownership, exact .next target, system Chrome launch, server cleanup, full-page capture, or artifact-scope verification cannot be established safely.
A focused check, build, browser assertion, Axe check, or integrity check fails twice for the same in-scope cause.
New run changes protected source/configuration/browser-test/snapshot/Docker hashes, touches T075 artifacts, leaves port occupied, or produces Axe serious/critical violations.
